name: Instantiate an oracle (ticker.cash v27)
description: Mints a new price-oracle head under the ticker.cash v27 covenant, over a notary table you choose, funded with your reserve. Any notary's public statements are usable by it from the first minute.

resources.name: ticker.cash
resources.description: The covenant, the notary table format and the registry of exchange ids.

founder.name: Founder
founder.description: Whoever funds the reserve and chooses the table.

fund.name: Receive the reserve
fund.description: Receive the coin that will fund the oracle. It must be output 0 of its transaction; its txid becomes the oracle's category.

create.name: Create the oracle
create.description: Mint the head over the notary table whose hash160 is $(tableHashHex). The category is the funding coin's txid.

founder.name: Create
founder.description: Spend the funding coin at input 0 into the oracle head.

fundTransaction.name: Reserve received
fundTransaction.description: Received $(<fundingSatoshis>) satoshis as the future reserve.

createTransaction.name: Oracle created
createTransaction.description: Minted an oracle head with a reserve of $(<reserveSatoshis>) satoshis.

fundingInput.name: Funding coin
fundingInput.description: The coin received by `fund`, spent at input 0 so its txid becomes the category.

fundingOutput.name: Funding coin
fundingOutput.description: The coin that will become the reserve; it must be output 0.

headOutput.name: Oracle head
headOutput.description: The minting NFT of the new oracle: commitment = timestamp ‖ 0 ‖ 0 ‖ 0 ‖ 0 ‖ hash160(table), computed by the template, holding the reserve.

oracleLockingScript.name: Oracle head
oracleLockingScript.description: The ticker.cash v27 Oracle covenant (P2SH-32). Every v27 oracle shares it; the category tells them apart.

founderLockingScript.name: Founder wallet
founderLockingScript.description: The founder's own funds in this template. A wallet offers `create` on a coin held here, with the coin as input 0.

founderKey.name: Founder key
founderKey.description: The key that holds the funding coin and receives change.

category.name: Category
category.description: The new oracle's category: the txid of the funding coin, the part of its outpoint before ":0". The coin must be output 0 of its transaction. Any other value makes the transaction invalid, so a typo cannot cost anything.

tableBytes.name: Notary table
tableBytes.description: n × (compressed pubkey 33 ‖ exchange id 1). Row order is permanent for this instance until its rows rotate it.

reserveSatoshis.name: Reserve
reserveSatoshis.description: Satoshis locked in the head to pay the oracle's fees.

startTimestamp.name: Start timestamp
startTimestamp.description: A minute start before the first update (Unix seconds, multiple of 60).
